args.code: (() => { const items = document.querySelectorAll('.shop-item, .seed-item, .product-item'); let result = []; for (let item of items) { const nameEl = item.querySelector('.item-name, .product-name, h3, h4'); const name = nameEl ? nameEl.textContent.trim() : item.textContent.trim().split('\n')[0]; if (name && name.includes('种子')) { result.push(name); } } if (result.length === 0) { const texts = document.querySelectorAll('*'); for (let el of texts) { const text = el.textContent.trim(); if (text.includes('种子') && text.length < 50 && text.length > 5) { result.push(text); } } } return JSON.stringify(result.slice(0, 30)); })()
